items.title: 8.1.4 Key Components of Digital Literacy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.1.4 (PDF 196-197), with MCQs 1 and 3 and long question 2 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Digital literacy mein kai aham maharatein shamil hain jo logon ko technology achhi tarah istemal karne mein madad deti hain. Digital literacy ke key components (aham hisse) neeche samjhaye gaye hain.

Technology istemal karne ka matlab hai computer, tablet aur smartphone jaise devices chalana. Is mein yeh aana shamil hai ke programs kaise kholein, applications (apps) kaise istemal karein aur websites par kaise navigate karein (ek page se doosre page tak jayein).
Misal: student school ke liye computer par report likhta hai. Use word processing software (jaise MS Word) chalana aana chahiye ta ke report type aur format (sajawat) kar sake.

Maloomat talash karne ka matlab hai search engines se internet par data dhoondna. Is maharat mein munasib (relevant) keywords likhna aur search results ko refine karna (chhaant kar behtar banana) shamil hai ta ke kaam ki maloomat mil jaye.
Misal: Punjab ka ek kisan fasal ki aabpashi (irrigation) ke naye tareeqe seekhna chahta hai. Woh Google par “modern irrigation techniques for wheat” jaise alfaaz search karta hai.

Sources ko evaluate karne (parakhne) ka matlab hai check karna ke online mili maloomat reliable hai ya nahi. Is mein dekha jata hai ke content kis ne banaya aur kya woh kisi bharose wale source se hai.

Misal: Lahore ki ek teacher ko website milti hai jo naye taleemi tareeqon ka daawa karti hai. Us ki maloomat istemal karne se pehle teacher check karti hai ke yeh website kisi educational institution ya credible (motabar) idare ki hai ya nahi.
Digital content banane ka matlab hai apna mawad khud tayyar karna, jaise articles likhna, presentations banana ya photos edit karna. Is ke liye mukhtalif software aur tools ka ilm chahiye.
Misal: Karachi ka ek student class project ke liye PowerPoint presentation banata hai. Woh presentation software se slides, text aur images (tasveerein) shamil karta hai.

Online safety aur privacy ka matlab hai apni zaati maloomat ki hifazat karna aur internet par mehfooz rehna. Is mein strong (mazboot) passwords istemal karna aur mumkina online threats (khatraat) ko pehchanna shamil hai.

Misal: Islamabad ka ek shakhs social media istemal karta hai aur privacy settings laga kar tay karta hai ke us ki zaati maloomat kaun dekh sakta hai. Woh suspicious (mashkook) links par click karne se bhi bachta hai ta ke online mehfooz rahe.

blocks.prompt: Digital literacy ka key component kaunsa hai? (MCQ 1)  Online sources ko achhi tarah evaluate karne ke liye kaunsi maharat zaroori hai? (MCQ 3)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 1: (c) Using digital tools effectively, kyunke kitab ke mutabiq digital literacy digital tools istemal karne ki salahiyat hai; poetry, khet-bari ya public speaking is ke components nahi. MCQ 3: (c) Checking if the content is from a trusted entity, kyunke Evaluating Sources ka matlab hai dekhna ke content kis ne banaya aur kya woh trustworthy source se hai. (Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key in dono ke liye (d) aur (b) deti hai, jo text se mel nahi khate; yahan text wala jawab diya gaya hai.)

blocks.prompt: Digital literacy aur us ke key components samjhaiye. Yeh digital tools aur resources ke achhe istemal mein kaise madad deti hai? (Long question 2)
blocks.explanation: Digital literacy digital tools (computer, smartphone, internet) se maloomat dhoondne, samajhne, banane aur share karne ki salahiyat hai. Is ke paanch components hain: (1) Using Technology: devices, programs aur apps chalana; (2) Searching for Information: sahi keywords se search karna aur results refine karna; (3) Evaluating Sources: dekhna ke content kis ne banaya aur source reliable hai ya nahi; (4) Creating Digital Content: articles, presentations aur edited photos banana; (5) Online Safety and Privacy: strong passwords, privacy settings aur mashkook links se bachna. In maharaton se insaan jaldi aur durust maloomat tak pohanchta hai, ghalat maloomat se bachta hai, apna kaam (report, presentation) achhi tarah banata hai aur apna data mehfooz rakhta hai.

items: Paanch components: Using Technology, Searching for Information, Evaluating Sources, Creating Digital Content, Online Safety and Privacy.
Har component ki kitab mein Pakistan se ek misal hai (Punjab ka kisan, Lahore ki teacher, Karachi ka student, Islamabad ka shakhs).
